m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Here it is - the Gardens District. It used to be romantic here... before the Thuggies took it. Their leader, Ali Baboon, he makes my skin crawl.
So this is pretty much the same drill as before. We need to shake down some of the Thuggie Goons and get them to tell us where their Stash is.
Why must you trouble us so? You wish to know the location of the Stash? It's right over there, but I warn you - it's well-guarded.
Oh my, what cheek! You dare to raid our Treasure Stash? Don't you know what Ali Baboon does to those who cross him? Well, you'll soon find out.
Stupid Thuggies! They don't know who we are, and neither will Ali Baboon. Get the Mask of Ejmir and I'll plant evidence the Fangs did this.
There it is. Now just a little Djinni magic... and Ali Baboon will blame the Fangs for stealing his treasure.
I must admit, when the Master and I cooked up this plan, I was skeptical, but with your help, it's working like a charm.
You have the Mask? Well done! Swan and the Hoods are watching the streets. It seems our actions are causing a stir, so the scheme is working.
And now it's Ali Baboon's turn. He and his Thuggie Goons had the nerve to steal the Mask of Ejmir from a Dromel Collector.
Go to the Gardens district, find their stash, and steal back the Mask. Istar, this time, plant evidence framing the Fangs gang for the theft.
Of course, Master. Oh! You know what? I could also use Djinni Magic to bring down a plague of snakes in the Gardens District...
That is... an interesting idea, Istar, but I think just planting evidence to implicate the Fangs is enough. Let's stick to the plan.
The Thuggies have their base of operations in the Gardens District. Go there, find their stash, and bring back the stolen Mask.
